steps: Run the unchanged v98 baseline in the pinned Firefox/FireMonkey target and record a concrete failure before proposing edits.

Inspect initGM modern and legacy branches, lexical GM binding, Promise behavior and value serialization against grant-gated mappings. Both storage API families are supported; mixed grants alone are not a runtime defect.

If evidence requires a change, preserve storage semantics and permission scope; do not blindly strip grants or substitute sync/async calls. Revalidate the exact candidate and obtain browser acceptance.
requiredEvidence: Unmodified v98 baseline browser observation bound to input hash
Concrete failure location and reproducible steps
Candidate static checks and real browser acceptance bound to output hash
